caption: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection v. E.I. du Pont de Nemours & Co.
citation_line: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection v. E.I. du Pont de Nemours & Co., Nos. 1:19-cv-14758, 1:19-cv-14765, 1:19-cv-14766 & 3:19-cv-14767 (D.N.J. Aug. 7, 2026)
headnote_district_ruling: Chief Judge Bumb approved four judicial consent orders resolving New Jersey's PFAS and other contamination claims involving DuPont-related industrial sites, after applying federal and state settlement-review standards and separately addressing objections and fee requests.
qualification_rationale: The orders implement an approximately $2.5 billion package, including cash payments and a remediation funding mechanism. The scale, environmental consequences, and extensive public attention make the approval a significant institutional decision even without appellate review.
appellate_posture_note: No merits appellate disposition was identified as of the research cutoff. The selection rests on practical impact, doctrinal settlement analysis, and press attention.
